note: eBird 2024 taxonomy split Setophaga petechia into S. aestiva (American Yellow Warbler) and S. petechia (Mangrove Yellow Warbler). GBIF/iNaturalist records under the lumped name 'Setophaga petechia' are overwhelmingly the widespread American form, so attribute them to yelwar1 (Setophaga aestiva). from_species_code lets an already-combined parquet be remapped at train time without re-running combine.py.
